text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text:
“And today is the Japan Cup!
Year after year, Japan's racing world has tasted bitter defeat!”

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text: "While Symboli Rudolf's withdrawal caused quite a stir, a lineup that's just as formidable will be racing. I'm sure they'll claim victory this year!"

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text: "『The one expected to achieve this historic first is, of course, the genius Mr. C.B....—』"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, shut up!
That—Japan's first crown belongs to me!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna snatch it away and make 'em see!
I'll show 'em that Katsuragi Ace is right here...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's a real shame Rudolf isn't here today.
I bet we would've seen an amazing race...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey...
I wonder if she'll run next year...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I just passed by Ace a moment ago.
For once, she didn't say a single word.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...She had an aura like a fierce demon. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Today is going to be the best race ever.
So amazing, they'll even forget the name Symboli Rudolf."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Who will claim the crown?
The Japan Cup begins now!"
